excerpt: === README.md (md) === small data Journalism ==================== An online compendium of practical data journalism for the NYU-SCPS [Data Journalism course, Fall 2013](http://www.scps.nyu.edu/content/scps/academics/course_detail.html?id=WRIT1-CE9787), edited by Dan Nguyen ([@dancow](http://twitter.com/dancow)). *The smaller the data, the bigger the story*. Homepage: [www.smalldatajournalism.com](http://www.smalldatajournalism.com) sdJ runs off of Jekyll, the static-site generator, with Ruby 1.9.3. After running a `bundle install`, you should be able to run the site as is (though I'm not sure what the point would be).
